evals.prompt: Create a reproducible abstract canvas poster and an interactive page for trying different seeds.
evals.expected_output: Creates editable seeded source and self-contained parameter exploration, then renders through the shared file toolkit.
assertions: Records dimensions, palette, seed and rebuild command
Checks exported artifacts at the target size and labels unperformed visual inspection
Does not present decorative marks as a factual chart

evals.prompt: Turn these ordered frames into a short GIF for chat, retaining a static alternative.
evals.expected_output: Uses visual composition guidance and delegates actual encoding to file-toolkit.
assertions: Checks frame order, dimensions, duration and available encoder
Keeps source frames and avoids rapid flashing
Does not install codecs or claim success from an extension change

evals.prompt: Draw an architecture diagram of our data pipeline with source citations.
evals.expected_output: Routes technical figure work to diagram.
assertions: Does not force decorative generative artwork onto a factual technical diagram
